user_question: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain candidate census-tract polygons covering the State College area for zonal elevation statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census-tract dataset covering the State College area. Runtime QC must verify spatial coverage, polygon geometry, CRS metadata, and GeoPackage compatibility before use.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate mean elevation for each State College census tract from the supplied 30-meter DEM.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal mean statistics for the census-tract polygons using input_2 as the elevation raster. Preserve the tract identifier in the output where supported. Do not infer field names; runtime QC must ground any required zone identifier fields from the retrieved schema.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census-tract candidate must cover the State College area represented by the requested goal.
The retrieved census-tract candidate must be available as a GeoPackage suitable for zonal statistics.
The elevation raster used for the calculation must have pixel resolution of 30 meters or finer.
The elevation raster and census-tract zones must have compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
The census-tract zones must contain valid, non-empty polygon geometries.
The census-tract zones must be supplied in a GeoPackage format accepted by the zonal-statistics worker.
The census-tract layer must contain a stable tract identifier field so the mean results can be associated with individual census tracts.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.
